## Checklist
- [ ] PR title starts with the Jira key (e.g. `CS385-27 Upload form validation`)

- [ ] Code is commented (TSDoc on exported components/functions, "why" comments on tricky logic)

- [ ] Acceptance criteria on the Jira ticket are met
